    if not root:
        return []
    result = []

        tmp = []

from typing import TypeVar, Generic, List

T = TypeVar('T')

class CustomIterator(Generic[T]):
    def __init__(self, elements: List[T]):
        self.elements = elements
        self.index = 0

    def __iter__(self) -> 'CustomIterator':
        return self

    def __next__(self) -> T:

            element = self.elements[self.index]
            self.index += 1
            return element
        else:
            raise StopIteration
